note: Corps campground on a peninsula in the Lindley Creek arm of Pomme de Terre Lake at Nemo, south of the Highway 64 bridge, with the marina across the road. Three clusters: sites 1-29 by the bridge (the non-electric sites are here), a west-shore loop (34-59) and the south point (60-103). Outer-side pads on the west loop and the south point back onto the shore across mown grass under scattered trees. Swim beach, boat ramp, playground and a separate group camp. Sites 71, 73, 75 and 87 have a second pedestal sold only when the campground is full. --Claude
summary: Confirmed rec.gov facility 233562: 80 individual sites (38 electric+water, 25 electric, 15 non-electric, 2 tent-only) + group camp, 20-45 ft, 50A on some, $18-$26 peak, season Mar 15-Nov 30 (reservable Apr 16-Sep 30), no FCFS, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max. Pin is on the marina 550 m north - move onto the loops. Phone to add. Lakefront lead: outer pads 10-35 m from shore, open apron.

The 80 catalog sites' centroid is 37.86125,-93.27507, on the peninsula between the west loop and the playground; on imagery the loops span 37.8593-37.8636. Suggested pin 37.86125,-93.27507.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored lakeview -> lakefront supported): on leaf-off Esri imagery (0.29-0.31 m/px) the pads on the OUTER side of the west-shore loop sit ~25-35 m from the waterline and the outer pads round the south point ~10-25 m, with only mown grass, scattered leafless trees and a bare 8-10 m shore band between (the band shows the lake at or a little below normal pool 839 ft, so at normal pool the gap is shorter). No loop road, day use or driveway lies between those pads and the water: the loop road is on the inland side. The swim beach is in the cove between the bridge cluster and the west loop, not in front of these pads. I count at least 8 outer pads on the west loop and at least 8 round the south point meeting the 50 m open-apron rule. Site numbers: rec.gov's per-site coordinates plot ~40-60 m SSW of the pads (the south-point sites land in the water), so numbers cannot be read off them exactly; by catalog order the west-loop outer sites are in the 45-59 range and the south-point ones in the 76-103 range, all STANDARD ELECTRIC 25-45 ft (a 23-ft rig fits). rec.gov tags only the group camp G1 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; no individual site carries the attribute. Evidence string suggestion: 'Esri leaf-off imagery 2026-11-09: outer pads of the west loop 25-35 m and of the south point 10-25 m from the shore across mown grass and scattered trees, no road between; rec.gov catalog coords offset, site numbers approximate (45-59, 76-103)'. The bridge cluster (1-29) is behind the highway embankment/cove and would be lakeview at most.
